name: Software update
oneLiner: a glass update dialog with the brand's app tile and what is new; a pointer presses Install, the dialog gives way to a progress ring that fills with a rolling percent, the card blacks out to restart with the mark and a boot bar, then it comes back up as the new version badge stamps in with a shock ring and an Up to date pill lands green
say: when the speaker announces a new version or says they upgraded something ('version two is out', 'I updated the whole system', 'it is a completely new version of me'): the press lands on 'install' or 'update', the badge stamps on the version or the new name. Set version, notes and app
